description: Applies any file modification following the full safety protocol: safety-level gate, archive-first check, and audit log entry.
checklist: 1. Classify the change: determine safety_level (low = reversible edit; medium = structural change; high = deletion, schema change, or breaking modification)
2. If safety_level is 'high' or 'medium': state the full change to the user and wait for explicit approval before proceeding
3. If the change removes or replaces an existing file: archive the original first per .ai/maintenance.md#archive-patterns — never delete without archiving
5. Call log-action tool to emit an audit entry to .ai/logs/
6. Report outcome to user with a one-line summary
